correctness.rationale: An acyclic orientation of a clique is a unique transitive tournament; every undirected cycle is contained in a single block. Thus orientations factor across blocks. The sole all-hub-sink configuration is corrected from weight 1 to z. Newton inequalities with e1>=r strictly control all adjacent coefficients including the modified first one. The quadratic discriminant exactly gives the iff real-rootedness boundary for r=3, and elementary derivatives give exact homogeneous real-root counts. Standalone independent edge-orientation enumeration checks 168 profiles; algebraic checks cover 21,824 coefficient profiles and 85,184 discriminant triples. These finite computations corroborate, rather than replace, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: A canonical graph family one notch beyond claw-free chordal graphs tests a new real-rootedness criterion on both sides. The theorem classifies the full three-block threshold and its re-entrant phenomenon, including real-rooted induced-claw examples (1,5,5) and nonreal examples (2,5,5), proves strict log-concavity for all heterogeneous multi-block bouquets despite failure of real-rootedness, and gives the exact homogeneous real-root count for arbitrary r. These are natural all-parameter structural conclusions motivated by the 2026 real-rootedness problem, not an arbitrary finite slice or a textbook normalization.
